steps.name: Guard
steps.text: This is the last one!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Target eliminated. The enemy squad is retreating!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}'s commands were perfect, just like Amiya said. How reassuring!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: See, that wasn't too bad, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, compared to everything you've been through, this is a walk in the park.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: *cough*...Why are you here... You're not from Ursus...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We won't... let you get in the way of our duties!
Don't even think about it!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Instructor!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What are you spacing out for? You almost got yourself killed!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I'm... I'm sorry!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Quick! Get back into formation!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dobermann! You made it!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It's an emergency. My team was attacked by Reunion as well.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I rushed over to join you as soon as I could.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why would Reunion attack us...?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: An organization made up of the Infected... I've always thought they were a bit extreme...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...and now they've resorted to violence, and in an Ursus city no less? That's a death wish.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The situation is only going to get more chaotic from here on out.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Amiya, we need to leave Chernobog right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay. We've already rescued the Doctor, so we can retreat according to plan.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...And this is Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, you probably don't know who I am, but you know Amiya. For your safety...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, no...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um, Dobermann, Doctor isn't doing very well right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: To put it simply, Doctor... has amnesia.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Amnesia?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...What are you going to do now? Weren't you planning to transfer leadership to—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor still has the capacity to command.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...At least, I've confirmed that from the previous battle.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I can't bring myself to trust a stranger so easily.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But I trust you, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I am Dobermann, captain of Op Team E1.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We are going to escort you from Chernobog, which is the Ursus city we're currently in, back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We're in an abandoned facility in Chernobog and should now head west.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... since we're cut off from Dr. Kal'tsit, Dobermann and I have lead our separate teams westward to a rendezvous point before confirming our signal to retreat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That is, assuming everything goes according to plan.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It'd be nice if things went that smoothly.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Today is our last opportunity to get you out of here, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But... I have a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: A-Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: It's... it's a call from Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are our communications back on? Is it Dr. Kal'tsit...?
Sorry, but not quite.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: PRTS...?

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: The Emergency Neural Connection Request System was activated.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Interference has also been detected from Rhodes Island's end, and only partial Neural Network connection is possible.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Currently unable to establish communication with Kal'tsit, who has yet to return to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Your safety is confirmed; therefore, my mission is now complete.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: This piece of...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Do we really have time for this...?

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: If you do not need to connect to Rhodes Island, communication will be severed momentarily.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: I am sincerely sorry for having interrupted your party.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, wait! Don't hang up, I need your help still.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dobermann, Doctor still needs some assistance.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I know, but make it quick.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, PRTS is also one of our... partners. It will show you what to do next.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Time is of the essence, so I'm going to reconnect you to the Rhodes Island backup system.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This way, we'll have an edge in battle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's different from giving verbal commands and might be a bit hard to get used to, but once you learn how to use it, the entire operation will be much smoother.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Please trust me. Just like how you used to.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: PRTS... Let's start.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Identity verification required. Select verification method.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, Doctor... Please say something.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: I am not sure why you did not speak, but the action of touching the interface is sufficient—

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: —Fingerprint match found. Verification complete. Security clearance: 8

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Welcome home, Dr. {@nickname}.
